name: gsr-typescript-monorepo
description: AWS Glue Schema Registry TypeScript client — npm workspaces monorepo root.

scripts.test:integ:real: bash -c 'if [ -z "$AWS_PROFILE" ] && [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then echo "test:integ:real: refusing to run — neither AWS_PROFILE nor AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is set. See packages/integration-tests/README-REAL-AWS.md." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "About to bill real AWS Glue in ${AWS_REGION:-us-east-2}. Press Ctrl-C within 5s to abort."; sleep 5; GSR_GLUE=real AWS_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts'
scripts.test:integ:interop:real: bash -c 'if [ -z "$AWS_PROFILE" ] && [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then echo "test:integ:interop:real: refusing to run — neither AWS_PROFILE nor AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is set. See packages/integration-tests/README-INTEROP.md." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "About to bill real AWS Glue and drive a Java sidecar + Kafka against ${AWS_REGION:-us-east-2}. Press Ctrl-C within 5s to abort."; sleep 5; GSR_GLUE=real AWS_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts'
scripts.demo:interop:real: bash -c 'if [ -z "$AWS_PROFILE" ] && [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then echo "demo:interop:real: refusing to run — neither AWS_PROFILE nor AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is set. See packages/integration-tests/demo/README.md." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "About to bill real AWS Glue and drive a Java sidecar + Kafka against ${AWS_REGION:-us-east-2}. Press Ctrl-C within 5s to abort."; sleep 5; GSR_GLUE=real AWS_INTEGRATION=1 vite-node packages/integration-tests/demo/main.ts'
